verdict.rationale: Base44 supports programmatic app creation and management through its CLI, which can create projects, sync data models and code, deploy, and run commands against any app on the account. It also offers an account-level MCP server for AI assistants and agent skills that create and deploy projects. However, there is no documented public platform REST API: OpenAPI probes all 404, and the SDK covers app data CRUD rather than platform-level app management. Missing for 10: a documented platform API (REST/OpenAPI) for creating and managing apps, programmatic prompt-to-app generation via API, details of the MCP server's management operations, and independent hands-on corroboration.
